item.title: OpenAI Moves To Hire Safety Executive As AI Risks Grow
item.description: OpenAI is recruiting a senior safety and preparedness executive to assess and mitigate risks tied to advanced AI systems.

item.title: SEC Crypto Policy Leader Cicely LaMothe Retires After 24 Years
item.description: Long-time SEC Corporation Finance deputy director Cicely LaMothe has retired after shaping staff guidance on crypto disclosures and digital assets.

item.title: Australians Lose Millions In Unlicensed Crypto Scheme
item.description: Australians lost millions after an unlicensed crypto scheme funneled retirement funds into high-risk digital asset investments.

item.title: Honda Confirms AI-Equipped Autonomous Hybrids, EVs For 2027
item.description: Honda said it plans to sell hybrid and electric vehicles with AI-based autonomous driving systems from 2027, pairing electrification with advanced driving software.

item.title: Zendesk Acquires Unleash To Build AI-First Employee Service Platform
item.description: Zendesk has acquired Unleash, an AI-powered enterprise search startup, to strengthen its employee service platform with secure, context-aware AI agents.

item.title: China’s Local Governments Begin Setting Up Dedicated AI Bureaus
item.description: China’s local governments are setting up dedicated AI bureaus to coordinate policy, computing resources, and industrial development at the city and district level.

item.title: China Unveils Autonomous ‘AI Scientist’ System
item.description: China has launched an AI system that runs scientific research workflows autonomously using its national supercomputing network.

item.title: OpenAI Steps Up Audio AI Work To Power Future Hardware Device
item.description: OpenAI is expanding its audio AI capabilities as it prepares speech-focused systems for a future consumer hardware device.

item.title: Trump Media Plans Digital Tokens For Shareholders
item.description: Trump Media said it plans to issue blockchain-based digital tokens to shareholders, extending its push into crypto-linked products tied to its public company structure.

item.title: Turkmenistan Legalizes Crypto Mining And Exchange Licences
item.description: Turkmenistan passed a law that legalizes cryptocurrency mining and establishes a licensing regime for exchanges under central bank oversight, marking a notable policy opening.
